_note: Synthetic HR policy corpus for the single-agent HR demo.

chunks.title: Paid time off accrual
chunks.content: Full-time employees accrue 1.5 days of paid time off per month, up to 20 days per year. Up to 5 unused days carry over to the next year.

chunks.title: Parental leave
chunks.content: Eligible employees receive 16 weeks of paid parental leave within 12 months of a birth, adoption, or foster placement.

chunks.title: Parental leave (superseded)
chunks.content: Eligible employees receive 12 weeks of paid parental leave.

chunks.title: Remote work
chunks.content: Employees may work remotely up to three days per week with manager approval. Fully remote arrangements require HR business partner approval.

chunks.title: Compensation bands (managers only)
chunks.content: Salary band ranges by level are confidential and visible to people managers only.
